description: This file defines the URL class in the Opencart system library, providing functionality to parse URLs, generate links, and apply rewrite rules within the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Url
classes.description: Class responsible for URL parsing, manipulation, and generation within the Opencart framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes URL object by parsing provided URL string into components.

methods.name: addRewrite
methods.description: Adds a rewrite rule object which must have a 'rewrite' method, to modify URLs.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Generates a URL with route and optional arguments, applying rewrite rules and encoding as needed.
